svg.title: LocationStatus — InBand, OutBand, SpanBand arc diagrams
svg.desc: Three arc diagrams showing all three LocationStatus variants for closed regions in pseudoknotted RNA structures.
svg.text: H-type pseudoknot: ((([[[)))...]]] — child (9,11) lies inside band interval [3,14]
Kissing loop: (((.[[[.)))...(((.]]].))): — child (10,11) lies in the gap between nested border pairs
parent (0,21) — pt[0]=9 ≠ 21 → pseudoknotted (Square arcs cross both Round stems)
pt[0]=9 < pt[21]=12 → nested borders → gap exists
Same H-type structure — loop between consecutive band rungs, assigned by enumerate_band_spanning_loops
parent (0,14) — pseudoknotted — two bands: Round [0,1,2] and Square [3,4,5]
One SpanBand loop per consecutive rung pair per band. Four total for this structure.
Not produced by location_status — assigned by enumerate_band_spanning_loops after the main classification.
